This First Appeal filed under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, is against the judgment and award dated 20.08.2012 passed in M.A.C.P. No. 2028 of 1997 on the file of Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (Aux) &
9TH Additional District Court, Godhara partially allowing the claim petition or compensation and seeking enhancement of compensation.

entities.text:
Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (Aux) &
9TH Additional District Court, Godhara
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This appeal coming on for conciliation before Lok Adalat, the following order is passed :

CONCILIATION ORDER 1. Learned advocate for the parties have jointly tendered compromise pursis dated 04.03.2025, which is taken on record, wherein, it is mentioned that the respondent No. 3 agrees to pay Rs.4,00,000/- inclusive of interest over and above the amount awarded by the Tribunal towards settlement of the matter and will deposit the said amount with the Tribunal within a period of three months from the date of receipt of the order of this Court and no further amount will be required to be paid to the claimant.
2.
In view of the compromise pursis submitted by both the learned advocates, this appeal stands disposed of as per the terms of compromise pursis.
No order as to costs.

3. The claimed amount lying with the bank in the form of FDs/ lying either with the Tribunal or with the Nazir Branch of this Court may be NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/2275/2015 CONCILIATION ORDER DATED: 08/03/2025 undefined disbursed in favour of the claimant after due verification by way of RTGS/NEFT.
4. Necessary Court fees, if any, be refunded to the appellant, as per the provisions of Section 21(1) of the Legal Services Authority Act, 1987.
5. The order passed in this appeal shall not be treated as precedent.
6. Registry is directed to transmit the record and proceedings to the Tribunal forthwith.
